description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents… “Golden Hour”, a beautifully appointed pet-friendly Seacrest Beach retreat designed for effortless coastal living and unforgettable time together. Ideally located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, this spacious 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home comfortably sleeps 12 guests and offers easy access to the iconic 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool, private beach access and some of the most beloved destinations along 30A. From morning coffee on the welcoming front porch to sunset gatherings on the expansive 3rd-floor deck, every space is thoughtfully designed for relaxation and connection. With 7 included bikes, multiple indoor and outdoor living areas and easy access to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and Peddler's Pavilion, this pet-friendly Seacrest Beach getaway is the perfect setting for your next 30A escape. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Prime Seacrest Beach Location: Easy access to the 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool, private beach access and the best of 30ASleeps 12 Comfortably: 5 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms thoughtfully designed for families and groupsPet-Friendly Retreat welcoming your four-legged family members along for the vacationExpansive 3rd-Floor Outdoor Retreat: Sun loungers, covered lounge seating, a raised entertaining bar and plenty of space for gathering above the treetopsEntertainment & Flex Space: 3rd-floor sitting area with workspace, board games, flat-screen TV and convenient kitchenetteChef-Inspired Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances, wine cooler, generous prep space and seating designed for gatheringExplore 30A with Ease: 7 bikes included for adventures to Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and nearby attractionsMultiple Gathering Spaces: Comfortable living areas spread across three levels allow everyone room to relaxWalkable to Local Favorites: Minutes from dining, shopping, entertainment and the charming communities of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach*** LIVING AREAS ***Designed for both connection and relaxation, this Seacrest Beach retreat offers inviting gathering spaces throughout the home. The main living area provides a comfortable place to unwind after beach days, while the 3rd-floor retreat creates additional space for movie nights, games, remote work or simply enjoying time together.Comfortable main living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVOpen-concept layout connecting the living, dining and kitchen spaces3rd-floor sitting area with flat-screen TV, board games and dedicated workspace with printerConvenient kitchenette featuring a Keurig, mini fridge and microwaveMultiple indoor and outdoor spaces designed for gathering and relaxation*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Whether you're preparing breakfast before heading to the beach or hosting dinner after a day by the pool, the well-equipped kitchen offers everything needed to cook and entertain with ease.Stainless steel appliances including a wine coolerGenerous counter space for meal preparationBar seating for 4Dining table with seating for 8Gas and charcoal grills for outdoor cookouts and entertaining*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Enjoy the relaxed rhythm of 30A living from multiple outdoor spaces designed for both quiet moments and memorable gatherings. With inviting outdoor living areas throughout the property, guests and their four-legged companions alike will have plenty of space to relax and enjoy the coastal lifestyle.Inviting front porch with comfortable seating for morning coffeePrivate balcony off the primary suite with cozy seating and bistro tablesExpansive 3rd-floor deck with sun loungers and a raised entertaining barCovered outdoor lounge featuring sectional seating and flat-screen TVGas and charcoal grills for outdoor dining and entertaining*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With five thoughtfully designed bedrooms spread across three levels, this home comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests while offering privacy and flexibility for families and groups.1st FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed and flat-screen TVGuest Bathroom: Single vanity and shower/tub combo2nd FloorQueen Bunk Room: Queen over Queen Bunk and flat-screen TVQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed and flat-screen TVShared Jack-and-Jill Bathroom: Dual vanities and shower/tub combo with direct access from the Queen Guest Suite & Bunk Room.Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities, walk-in shower and soaking tub3rd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerHalf Bathroom conveniently located off the sitting area*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, this home places you within one of 30A's most desirable communities, known for its resort-style amenities, walkability and proximity to some of the area's most iconic destinations.Seacrest Lagoon Pool: Enjoy access to the 12,000 sq ft resort-style pool with expansive lounging areas and family-friendly designPrivate Beach Access: Easily reach the sugar-white sand and emerald Gulf waters via community beach accessSeasonal Beach Tram: Convenient transportation to and from the beach during peak seasonsPeddler's Pavilion: Walk or bike to dining, shopping, live music and local favoritesRosemary Beach: Explore charming cobblestone streets, boutiques, coffee shops and award-winning restaurantsAlys Beach: Discover stunning architecture, beautiful green spaces and upscale diningScenic 30A Bike Path: Miles of paved pathways connecting the area's most beloved beach communitiesEasy access to Camp Helen State Park, Inlet Beach and South Walton's famous coastal dune lakes*** PET FRIENDLY ***Non shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsMust be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dogPets are not allowed in the pool at anytimeWith non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to access the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesPlease be advised there is a Ring doorbell camera located on the front porch of the home*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we're committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection and unforgettable coastal memories.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! *** Read less
